decisions.quote:
In general, we were able to reproduce Alvarez et al.’s major empirical results, except
with minor discrepancies in the statistics involving simulations. Table 1 reports our
reproduced summary statistics and main empirical estimates, corresponding to Table
1 in Alvarez et al. (2022). Our program reproduced the exact results as Alvarez et al.’s
except the bootstrapped standard errors for the kurtosis for pooled observations and
the kurtosis with unobserved heterogeneity, shown in parentheses in column 6 and 7,
respectively.
decisions.reason: The authors conclude overall that they reproduced the original study's major empirical results in Table 1 after minor script adjustments, with only negligible (<0.01) simulation differences in some bootstrapped standard errors and auxiliary estimates. Under the codebook, script edits and negligible numerical differences in a reproduction that recovers the central reported numbers map to 'computationally reproducible'.
